response.explanation: At line 6, src/presentation/server.ts imports SessionRepository from the persistence layer. It never calls the repository for data. It only builds it once (line 18) and passes that instance into the business services: SessionService (line 30), BookingService (line 36), IceMonitorService (line 45) and ReportService (line 52). So server.ts works as the app's composition root, the startup file that wires everything together. It sits in the presentation folder, though, so its static import goes straight from presentation to persistence and skips the business layer. FF-S03 forbids that layer skip, and it can't tell wiring code apart from route handlers that query persistence directly. Lines 1–4, 9 and 10 import other persistence modules the same way, so this edge is one of several. None of the material provided (docs, ADRs or code comments) says the composition root may sit in presentation or may reach into persistence.
